failure_modes: Not evaluated out-of-distribution: different volatility regime, jump risk, or real market microstructure.
Trained and evaluated with a single random seed per call; objective_history shows convergence on that one training seed, not across seeds.
No formal verification that the tanh action bound [-1, 1] is appropriate outside a single-share-per-option vanilla setting.
Synthetic, single-asset GBM; one firm and two households; prices/wages are exogenous.
Monthly dt=1/12; business-day dates are labels, not an actual/365 day-count basis.
The current step's policy rate funds that entire interval; hedges use observed spots.
Hedge accounts are separate from the economic ledger; there is no joint balance sheet.
Conditional CVaR freezes holdings and the current rate, with physical GBM continuation; it does not simulate future rehedging, policy shocks or parameter uncertainty.
Training uses constant initial-rate GBM; the scenario can change rates out of sample.
Terminal liquidation is frictionless, matching the shared batch hedge convention.
One realized path cannot establish policy superiority; no independent review exists.
model_cards.input_schema_summary: Per path per step: (log(S_t / strike), fraction of time-to-maturity remaining in [0, 1], previous holding in [-1, 1]), each a float32 scalar. Output: a tanh-bounded target holding in [-1, 1].
model_cards.intended_use: Research demonstration of CVaR-based deep hedging (Buehler et al. 2019) on synthetic single-asset European-option GBM paths. Not calibrated to, or validated against, real market data.
model_cards.metric_uncertainty_note: One independent realized scenario, not an estimate of CVaR or policy superiority. Per-step conditional risk uses frozen holdings and constant current rates.
model_cards.model_type: Feedforward MLP hedging policy (3 inputs, 2 hidden layers of 32 units, tanh-bounded scalar output)
model_cards.prohibited_use: Any live trading, order routing, or real-money hedging decision. Any use outside the single-asset European vanilla call/put GBM setting it was trained on (not evaluated under Heston, jumps, multiple assets, or real market microstructure).
model_cards.training_data_summary: 1500 synthetic GBM paths (prometheus.stochastica.gbm), physical-measure, seed=1692854635; no empirical/historical data. Policy seed=4115070539.

limitations: Synthetic, single-asset GBM; one firm and two households; prices/wages are exogenous.
